translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Nonaw ni Juan no Tohodboutismu
Na, to id lihad kos pilon mgo lahun, mid undiyon si Juan no Tohodboutismu to noka-awoy-awoy'n lugaa to Judea. Id ponudtuu rin kos kahit Monama riyot mgo minuvu no mid undiyon to kandin. Kahi rin to,
“Sondit kow woy tanan kowd to mgo saa row, su asow ron kos kodharit Monama.”
Si Juan en iddos od tommanon ni propeta Isaias no,

content.text: “Duwon monokkaan bawos diyot noka-awoy-awoy'n lugaa no mid ungketen to,
‘Ponaya row kos pusung dow atag tod Longaggon,
woy tulidda row kos od ukitan din.’ ”

content: Na iddos umpak ni Juan, binovallan pomot bowvuu to kamelyo woy dos ollon din, binovallan pomot kindaa to oyama.
Iyon ko-uyahan din, mgo apang woy tonnob.
Mid undiyon to kandin iddos mgo minuvu no id pomon diyot Jerusalem, pomon diyon to intirut prubinsya to Judea woy pomon diyot mgo lugaa no moranit Oweg to Jordan.
Id ponudtuu ran no id sondit woy id tanan don sikandan to mgo saa ran, woy id poboutismu sikandan ki Juan diyot Oweg to Jordan.

Na, duwon mandad mgo ponguu to pomokayon to Judio nod ngoranan no Pariseo woy Saduseo no id undiyon amoy'd poboutismu. Piru to nokita rin sikandan, id ikohiyan din to, “Sikiyu, iling kow to mgo uwod nod laas! Kunan dow ayu kod pokolegguang kowd taddot od ingumon kodsilut to Monama otid koboutismuwan kowd.
Otik bonnaa en no id sondit woy id tanan kowd to mgo saa row, posivonnali row ini ukit to koniyun pinuungan.
Yo kowd pososalig no dii kow od silutan pomon to koubbaran kow ni Abraham. Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no ahad inis mgo batu, od kovovallan to Monama no koubbaran ni Abraham.
Pomotawi row! Dos kodsilut to Monama koniyu, noko-iling to porokuu no nopanoy ron nid tampod to kayu. Na, iddos ipat kayu no diid bovunga to moppiya, od tompoddon woy id lumbag diyot apuy.

“Od boutismuwan ku sikiyu to oweg, patow no id sondit woy id tanan kowd to mgo saa row. Piru konnod kouhoy, duwon od tundug koddi no lampas pa no motuus, su konna a ollog ahad kodbitbit da to sandalyas din. Uhis no Ispiritu woy apuy kos id boutismu rin koniyu.

Od pod-ossan din iddos mgo minuvu no moppiya woy morat iling to minuvu nod oottap to trigu. Dos moppiyon trigu, id ta-aw rin diyot budiga, piru iddos mgo ottap, od tirukkan din diyot apuy no konnod ko-ovukkan.”
Dos Kodboutismu ki Disas
Na riyot timpu to kodboutismu ni Juan, mid undiyon si Disas to Oweg to Jordan pomon diyot prubinsya to Galilea amoy'd poboutismu kandin.
Piru dii nanoy od boutismu si Juan kandin. Kahi rin to, “Siyak kos ollog nod boutismuwan du, konna siyak kos od boutismu kikow.”
Piru mid tavak si Disas to, “Boutismu-i a en, su ollog en nod kotuman ta iddos langun no id kopi-it Monama.” De-en id boutismuwan ni Juan si Disas.
To noboutismuwan don si Disas, id go-un sikandin diyot oweg. Woy idda ron en, nopokes kos langit, woy nokita rin no id lonna iddos Uhis no Ispiritu riyot kandin iling to soopati.
Na, duwon bawos pomon diyot datas to langit no mid ungketen to, “Ini en kos Anak ku no id dokollan ku to ginawa woy oraroy ku nid kahaa-i.”

footnotes.text: Dos umpak ni Juan no Tohodboutismu, iling to umpak ni propeta Elias. Od kovasa ini riyot 2 Hari 1:8. Nokod-iling mandad iddos id poponudtuu to Monama ki Juan taddot ki Elias, oyya su id ponudtuu ran diyot mgo minuvu iddos moka-atag to kodsilut to Monama, woy dos moka-atag to kodsondit woy kodtanan to mgo saa.
